subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) Mandela joined the African National Congress in 1942. (b) In 1993, Mandela was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. (c) For 20 years, he directed a campaign of peaceful, nonviolent defiance against the South African Government and its racist policies. (d) Mandela died at his home in Johannesburg on December 5, 2013, at the age of 95. (e) In 1993, South African President FKW de klerk was also awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. (f) In 2009, Mandelas' birthday was declared 'Mandela Day' to promote global peace. (g) Nelson Mandela was born of July 18, 1918 in South Africa. (h) 1994, Mandela was celebrated as South African first black President.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
